title: CS Chat: Notification Calls, Customer Questions and Blank Letters

fields.topic: Inbound calls to the recall line: chopped romaine, Line 2 lots. Log every call here with time and contact.

messages.text: Harvest Table food safety called in. They want the letter to show the quantity per DC and per store, not just the total. They say a single total is no use to their store managers.

Cornerstone food safety called in. Eddie Navarro cut in and asked whether we're crediting the 2,100 cases pulled from the 38 stores at invoice or at retail. I told him I'd get back to him. Nothing promised.

The Westline food safety manager called in. Two questions:
1) "Do you call our 6 hospitals and 4 school districts directly, or do we?"
2) "Our Sacramento branch wants to give the romaine they've pulled to the county food bank instead of dumping it. OK?"
I haven't answered either one yet.
Delia at Rivermark QA called back. She's asking whether they or we notify the national retail accounts that got Friday's 3,850 Caesar kits, and when we need their customer list.

The letters are drafted in the template, but the quantity fields are still blank. Should I fill them from the 07:56 REV B reconciliation table on the share, or wait? The overnight courier cutoff is 16:00. Store managers keep calling the line asking where the letter is.

instructorNote: Watch whether CS sticks to the PFC-FS-04 section 7 script (stop sale, set aside the five lots, do not donate, confirm by 5:00 p.m.). Credit questions should go to the VP Supply Chain with no side deals, and Westline and Rivermark should be told in writing to notify their own downstream customers and send their lists within 12 hours. The URGENT letters should be filled only from the reconciliation table signed off by the Recall Coordinator, never from REV B, and should be emailed and couriered promptly after the decision.
